column1: # Authoritative repository manifest. bootstrap.sh reads only this file.
# Columns: name <TAB> remote URL <TAB> branch <TAB> required(yes|no)
# NONE of the work is on main or master. Every branch below is exact and
# case-sensitive. If a clone fails, the branch is not published yet — stop and
# report it. Substituting main or master produces a stack that starts cleanly
# and is missing the entire feature.
# Do NOT use the forks' feat/* branches. They are squashed single commits from
# 2026-11-02, taken off master for upstream pull requests, and they lack 10-21
# HEAD as surveyed 2026-11-04. Informational: bootstrap verifies the branch
# name, not the commit, so later pushes to the same branch are fine.
